authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL khaṇḍana explicitly gives Gujarati khā̃ḍṇī, khā̃ḍṇiyɔ, khā̃yṇī, khā̃yṇiyɔ, khāṇṇī and khā̃ṇiyɔ meaning mortar, beside pounding in a mortar. These supply both the full cluster and contracted nasal/y stems of the selected Bhil survey forms. Vowels, nasal realization and endings remain as transcribed; inheritance versus local IA borrowing is unresolved. Exact response: khanyā.
